problem_restatement.input: The MU breakout observer records source-native completed candles, decisions, and exact L2 snapshots.
problem_restatement.failed_output: Seven of eight prior lifecycle replays were censored, including mark-path-unresolved entries, and no prospective MU mark recorder was running.
problem_restatement.success_criterion: Record exact source-native MU mark observations prospectively so future eligible lifecycles can be evaluated without midpoint or oracle substitution.

causal_boundary.first_eligible_lifecycle_that_can_be_mar: the first eligible onset whose entry and entire lifecycle occur at or after the capture start
causal_boundary.reason: The recorder began more than two hours after the ninth onset and cannot fabricate pre-start mark observations.

risk_and_failure_modes: The recorder can stop while the decision observer remains healthy.
Three-second polling does not prove a continuous mark path through faster intrainterval gaps.
A future lifecycle can still be censored by missing entry depth, L2, candle, funding, or process continuity.
Mark capture improves technical evidence but does not establish strategy profitability or bidirectional edge.
All nine eligible onsets remain long, leaving short behavior unobserved.

monitoring_and_falsifiers.health_rule: The mutable status must remain fresh, authority-none, signer-false, orders-false, and rows_by_symbol.xyz:MU must increase.
monitoring_and_falsifiers.path_rule: A future eligible lifecycle may be called technically resolved only if every held interval satisfies the declared mark-gap contract.
falsifiers: status freshness exceeds the declared observer tolerance
row count stops advancing while the market and decision observer advance
any status grants execution authority, constructs a signer, or supports orders
an evaluation silently fills pre-start or missing mark intervals
a future onset remains mark-path censored despite recorder continuity

next_investigation.1_recommendation: Keep the exact MU decision, L2, and mark observers running report-only; evaluate the next eligible onset only after its lifecycle resolves or at the predeclared 20-path/first-short review boundary.
next_investigation.2_why_now: Missing prospective mark capture was a direct cause of technically censored MU lifecycle evidence.
next_investigation.3_evidence_reviewed: 342 decisions, nine long onsets, prior lifecycle replay, current observer health, recorder implementation, focused tests, and a real mainnet one-poll probe.
next_investigation.4_observed_problem_or_opportunity: MU has promising fixed-horizon long markouts but cannot support a live strategy claim while most lifecycle paths are censored and no short onset exists.
next_investigation.5_applicable_market_regime: Frozen 15m breakout-pressure route with EMA9/21, 32-bar breakout, and absolute depth-10 imbalance at least 0.10.
next_investigation.6_alternatives_considered: Use midpoint/oracle fallback, rerun historical incomplete paths, wait without mark capture, or start an unsigned exact prospective recorder. Only the final option preserves causal evidence.
next_investigation.8_expected_upside: Convert future eligible MU onsets from predictable mark-path censors into evaluable stop, exit, funding, and stress lifecycles.
next_investigation.9_main_risks_and_failure_modes: Recorder outage, sampling gaps, one-sided onset selection, winner concentration, pressure-transport mismatch, and incomplete execution-cost evidence.
next_investigation.10_validation_completed: Recorder TDD, unsigned mainnet probe, first persistent heartbeat, immutable parquet publication, and process/status contract verification.
next_investigation.11_validation_still_required: Fresh future eligible onsets after the capture boundary, resolved long and short lifecycles, exact costs and funding, source transport parity, stress robustness, and untouched confirmation.
next_investigation.12_success_metrics: Zero unresolved prospective mark intervals, at least 20 independent paths with both sides represented, positive stress expectancy and largest-winner sensitivity, and incremental portfolio value.
next_investigation.13_failure_or_rollback_triggers: Stop and repair the research recorder on stale/invalid status or path gaps. No live rollback exists because v51 was not changed.
next_investigation.14_confidence_level: High that the missing prospective mark-capture gap is fixed for post-start data; low that MU has a deployable edge.
